title: Primary Six Mathematics — Term 3, Week 3: Trapezium, Parallelogram, Rhombus, Kite and Cube (Lessons 1–6)

block_updates.text: Class: Primary Six (P6). Subject: Mathematics. Term: Three. Week: Three. Topic: Length, mass and capacity. This week contains six lessons on plane shapes and cubes.

A trapezium has exactly one pair of parallel sides in these notes. A kite has two distinct pairs of equal adjacent sides. A general kite of this kind has one line of symmetry, while a rhombus has two lines of symmetry.

Activity: Draw a trapezium. Mark its parallel sides. Measure each side with a ruler. Add the four measurements to calculate its perimeter. Compare answers with a partner. Use measurements from your own drawing.

Activity: Examine a clean, closed cube-shaped box or a cube model. Count its faces, edges and vertices. Sketch a net of six equal squares. Imagine the net folded into a cube. Explain why the total surface area consists of six square faces.

parts.text: 1. Define perimeter. 2. Draw a trapezium and mark the parallel sides.
3. Draw and label a parallelogram ABCD.
4. State two properties of a rhombus.
5. Draw a kite and show its symmetry line.
6. Explain the difference between the area of a flat shape and the volume of a solid.
7. A trapezium has sides 13 cm, 9 cm, 10 cm and 8 cm. Find its perimeter. 8. The perimeter of a trapezium is 58 cm. Three sides are 20 cm, 13 cm and 11 cm. Find the fourth side.
9. A parallelogram has a base of 15 cm and perpendicular height of 8 cm. Find its area. 10. A parallelogram has area 132 cm² and base 11 cm. Find its height.
11. A rhombus has a side of 12 cm. Find its perimeter. 12. The diagonals of a rhombus are 14 cm and 18 cm. Find its area.
13. A kite has diagonals measuring 16 cm and 9 cm. Find its area. 14. A kite has two sides measuring 9 cm each and another two measuring 12 cm each. Find its perimeter.
15. A cube has side 6 cm. Find its volume. 16. Find the total surface area of the cube in Question 15.

17. A cube has volume 343 cm³. Find its side. 18. A cube has total surface area 486 cm². Find its side. 19. Find the volume of the cube in Question 18. 20. Explain how you can check whether your answer for a cube's side is correct.
